y-m-77-01.title: Kutarisa nhamba dzereporo yokukurumidza kwokuendesa nokudzoka
y-m-77-01.goal: Tarisa nokuverenga kuti kukurumidza kwepakati korwendo rwokuenda nokudzoka kungasaenzana neavhareji yakareruka yokukurumidza kuviri, uye utaure kuti dzinoenzana riini.
y-m-77-01.material: Mutyairi wokuendesa akaita rwendo rwokuenda nokudzoka pachinhambwe chorwendo rumwe che 12 km. Paunoenda, mutyairi akaenda 30 km paawa, uye paunodzoka, 20 km paawa (fungidzira kuti hapana kumira uye kukurumidza kwakagadzikana pamutsetse wega wega). Ripoti yomushandi mumwe inoiverenga sezvinotevera.
y-m-77-01.thinking.0: Tsvaga mutsetse mukuripoti unosvetukirwa pasina chikonzero
y-m-77-01.thinking.1: Tarisa kukosha uchishandisa tsananguro dzechinhambwe chose nenguva yose
y-m-77-01.thinking.2: Gadzira mapeya akati wandei okukurumidza anosangana namamiriro
y-m-77-01.prereq.0: Mubasa iri, 'H3' chiratidzo chenhanho yokuoma nokutsigira mukugoverwa kwokugadzira uku chete. Haireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa chidzidzo ichi kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti masvomhu ebasa echikoro chepamusoro anotorwa panhanho yepamusoro, uye kuti wakatoziva mareshiyo echikoro chepakati, kasiyo, mavhareji, nezvirevo zvine mavara.
y-m-77-01.prereq.1: Kukurumidza = chinhambwe ÷ nguva, chirevo cheavhareji (nhanho yechikoro chepakati)
y-m-77-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mubasa romushandi wako usina hwaro kana wakanganisa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse wega wega, paradzanisa kana wakangotakura mamiriro edambudziko (chinhambwe, kukurumidza) kana unoita chirevo chitsva.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga nguva yakatorwa paunoenda nenguva yakatorwa paunodzoka, nyora huwandu, uye uise kukosha uku padivi penguva inoverengwa mukuripoti kuti uienzanise.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuenda: famba 12 km pa 30 km paawa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.1: Kudzoka: dzoka 12 km pa 20 km paawa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.2: Kukurumidza kwepakati ndiyo avhareji yokukurumidza kuviri, saka (30+20)÷2 = 25 km/h.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.3: Rwendo rwokuenda nokudzoka rwe 24 km runogona kuitwa pa 25 km paawa, saka nguva inotorwa ndi 24÷25 = maawa 0.96.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.explain: Mitsetse 1 ne 2 inongokopa mamiriro, saka yakarurama. Mutsetse 3 ndipo pakatanga dambudziko. Kukurumidza kwepakati ndi 'chinhambwe chose ÷ nguva yose', asi kunyange nguva dzokuenda nokudzoka dzakasiyana, kukurumidza kuviri kwakaitwa avhareji nehuremu hwakaenzana. Chaizvo, kuenda kunotora 12÷30=maawa 0.4 uye kudzoka kunotora 12÷20=maawa 0.6, saka rwendo rwose runotora awa 1, uye kukurumidza kwepakati ndi 24÷1=24 km/h. Mutsetse 4 unoshandisa 25 yomutsetse 3 sezvayakaita, zvichipa nguva isina kururama yemaawa 0.96. Kunyange wakasarudza mutsetse 3 kana mutsetse 4, wakaona mutsetse wakanganisa, asi chikonzero ndi mutsetse 3.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira kuti nzira imwe chete inofambwa nokukurumidza kwe a km paawa paunoenda uye b km paawa paunodzoka. Gadzira mapeya maviri akasiyana (a, b) umo kukurumidza kwepakati kworwendo rwose rwokuenda nokudzoka (chinhambwe chose ÷ nguva yose) inhamba yechisikigo. a ne b dzinhamba dzechisikigo dzakasiyana kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 100, uye chinhambwe chorwendo rumwe hachina basa. (30, 20) yatopiwa semuenzaniso, saka ichisiye. (a, b) ne (b, a) zvinoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ita chinhambwe chorwendo rumwe chive 12 km, uye kune musarudzwa (a, b) wega wega, tsvaga nguva yokuenda nenguva yokudzoka uye uizvedzere.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kumapeya akati wandei akasarudzwa, rongedza patafura kana chinhambwe chose chakaparadzanwa nenguva yose chiri nhamba yechisikigo, uye utarise chii chakafanana pakati pemapeya anopa nhamba yechisikigo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b dzinhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita a ne b dzive nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c3: (30, 20) yatopiwa semuenzaniso. Edza kutsvaga peya yakasiyana.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Kukurumidza kwepakati kworwendo rwokuenda nokudzoka inhamba yechisikigo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Kukurumidza kwepakati kworwendo rwokuenda nokudzoka hakusi nhamba yechisikigo. Verengazve chinhambwe chose nenguva yose.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana chinhambwe chorwendo rumwe chiri d, nguva ndi d/a+d/b uye kukurumidza kwepakati ndi 2ab/(a+b). Kune (60, 40) ndi 48, kune (40, 10) ndi 16, uye kune (60, 30) ndi 40. Pasinei nokuti wasarudza peya ipi, kukurumidza kwepakati kuri pasi kana kwakaenzana neavhareji yakareruka yokukurumidza kuviri. Kunoenzana neavhareji yakareruka chete kana kukurumidza kuviri kwakafanana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangurira mushandi wako 'sei avhareji isiri 25'. Shandisa nguva dzokuenda nokudzoka sehumbowo, uye uwedzere mutsara mumwe pamusoro pokuti paine nyaya apo avhareji yakareruka yokukurumidza kuviri yakarurama here.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora nguva yokuenda nenguva yokudzoka senhamba.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.1: Edza kutanga nomutsara unoenzanisa nguva yakaverengwa ne 25 (maawa 0.96) nenguva yakatorwa chaizvo.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here nemashoko ako kuti nguva dzokuenda nokudzoka dzakasiyana?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakapa here kukosha kwakaverengwa kubva pachinhambwe chose nenguva yose senhamba?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here mamiriro 1 e 'nyaya apo avhareji yakareruka yakarurama'?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.0: Kukurumidza kwepakati ndicho chinhambwe chose chakaparadzanwa nenguva yose. Kuenda kunotora 12÷30=maawa 0.4 uye kudzoka kunotora 12÷20=maawa 0.6, saka zvinotora awa 1 zvose, uye sezvo mutyairi akaenda 24 km, ndi 24 km/h. Kudzoka kunononoka, saka kunotora nguva refu, ndicho chikonzero chokuti isiri 25. Avhareji yakareruka yakarurama kana kukurumidza kuviri kwakafanana, kana nguva dzemitsetse miviri dzakafanana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.1: Dai mutyairi akaenda pa 25, aifanira kutora 24÷25=maawa 0.96, asi chaizvo zvinotora 0.4+0.6=awa 1. Nguva yakashandiswa pakukurumidza kwakanyanya kunonoka ireba, saka avhareji ndi 24, iri pasi pe 25. Dai kukurumidza kwokuenda nokudzoka kwakafanana, avhareji yakareruka yaizova yakarurama.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inopa mamiriro okuti avhareji yakareruka ive yakarurama se 'kana kukurumidza kwakafanana' chete inogamuchirwawo.

y-m-77-03.title: Mutengo wokurongedza mabhokisi: mutemo mumwe unopa mutengo wakaderera zvikuru here?
y-m-77-03.goal: Ratidza nokuverenga kuti mutemo wokuti 'shandisa mabhokisi anodhura zvishoma pachinhu chimwe nechimwe akawanda sezvinogoneka' haubvumi mutengo wakaderera zvikuru kuodha iyi, uye gadzira nzira dzakati wandei dzokurongedza dzinosangana namamiriro.
y-m-77-03.material: Dura rinoda kutumira zvikamu 100 zvakaparadzaniswa kuva marudzi maviri emabhokisi. Bhokisi guru (L) rinobata zvikamu 12 zvakanyanya uye rinodhura 1,500원 bhokisi rimwe nerimwe, uye bhokisi diki (S) rinobata zvikamu 8 zvakanyanya uye rinodhura 1,100원 bhokisi rimwe nerimwe. Mabhokisi anogona kusiya nzvimbo dzisina chinhu, asi zvikamu zvose 100 zvinofanira kurongedzwa. Mabhokisi chero huwandu anogona kushandiswa. Mushandi mumwe akataura mutengo wakaderera zvikuru nenzira iyi.
y-m-77-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira musanganiso wokurongedza uri muenzaniso unopikisa
y-m-77-03.thinking.2: Kutsvaga mamiriro umo mutemo unoshanda zvirokwazvo
y-m-77-03.prereq.1: Mhinduro nechasara pakuparadzanisa, kusaenzana kwemutsetse (nhanho yechikoro chepakati)
y-m-77-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe muchirevo chomushandi une kushaya hwaro kana wakanganisa.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga watarisa iwe pachako kana kuverenga kwemitsetse 1 ne 3 kwakarurama.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira misanganiso yakati wandei inoshandisa mabhokisi makuru anopfuura 8 shoma, utarise kana zvikamu zvose 100 zvichikwana, uye uverenge mutengo.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.0: Bhokisi guru rinodhura 1,500÷12 = 125원 pachinhu chimwe nechimwe, uye bhokisi diki rinodhura 1,100÷8 = 137.5원 pachinhu chimwe nechimwe.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.1: Saka, kushandisa mabhokisi makuru akawanda sezvinogoneka ndiko kwakachipa zvikuru.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.2: 100÷12 ine mhinduro 8 nechasara 4, saka shandisa mabhokisi makuru 8 (e zvinhu 96) nebhokisi diki 1 (rezvinhu 4 zvasara).
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.3: Mutengo i 1,500×8 + 1,100×1 = 13,100원, uye uyu ndiwo mutengo wakaderera zvikuru.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga mutengo pachinhu chimwe mumutsara 1 nekuverenga quotient neremainder mumutsara 3 zvakarurama. Mutsara 2 unotora mutemo wakajairika wekuti 'inodhura zvishoma pachinhu chimwe, saka shandisa dzakawanda sezvinogoneka' pasina chikonzero. Munzira yemutsara 3, bhokisi rimwe diki rine nzvimbo 4 dzisina chinhu, asi kana ukashandisa mabhokisi makuru 7 nemadiki 2, unozadza chaizvo zvinhu 84+16=100, uye mutengo i10,500+2,200=12,700원. 13,100원 yemutsara 4 haisi iyo yakaderera zvikuru. Kunyange kana wakasarudza mutsara 2 kana mutsara 4, wakaona mutsara usina kururama.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa mabhokisi makuru a nemadiki b, gadzira misanganiswa yekurongedza inobata zvikamu 100 kana kupfuura uye inodhura zvishoma kupfuura 13,100원 yakataurwa nemushandi. a ne b maintegers ari 0 kana kupfuura. Wana misanganiswa 2 yakasiyana.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chinja nhamba yemabhokisi makuru a kuita 5, 6, 7, ne8, uye uwane nhamba diki yemabhokisi madiki anodiwa kubata zvinhu 100.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kune kandidate yega yega, nyora mutebhura kana nhamba yenzvimbo i100 kana kupfuura uye kana mutengo uri pasi pe13,100, uye uongorore.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba yemabhokisi inhamba yakazara i0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba yemabhokisi inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara i0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Musanganiswa uyu haugoni kubata zvinhu 100. Verenga zvakare nzvimbo dziri mumabhokisi.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Mutengo i13,100원 kana kupfuura. Tsvaga musanganiswa unodhura zvishoma.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.explain: Misanganiswa chete inoita mamiriro i (7, 2) ne (5, 5). (7, 2) inodhura 12,700원 uye ine nzvimbo 100 chaiyo. (5, 5) inodhura 7,500+5,500=13,000원 uye ine nzvimbo 100 chaiyo. Hapana ine nzvimbo isina chinhu. Nzira yekushandisa mabhokisi makuru 8 uye kuisa zvasara mubhokisi diki inosiya nzvimbo 4 dzisina chinhu mubhokisi diki rekupedzisira.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.prompt: Pamurairo upi pawunogona kutaura nechokwadi kuti mutemo 'shandisa mabhokisi anodhura zvishoma pachinhu chimwe nehuwandu hwakawanda sezvinogoneka, uye uise zvikamu zvasara mubhokisi diki' unopa mutengo wakaderera zvikuru? (Mitengo nehukuru hwemabhokisi zvinoramba zvakafanana.)
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.0: Pamurairo wega wega, enzanisa mutengo wekurongedza nemutemo nemutengo kana ukashandisa bhokisi guru rimwe shoma uye mabhokisi madiki akawanda.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa mirairo umo mutemo unosiya nzvimbo dzisina chinhu nemirairo umo usingasiyi.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.a: Kunyange nezvikamu 98, mabhokisi makuru 7 nemadiki 2 (12,700원) anodhura zvishoma kupfuura mabhokisi makuru 8 nebhokisi diki 1 (13,100원). Uyu murairo umo mutemo unoputsika.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.b: Nzvimbo dzinokodzera chaizvo nemabhokisi makuru oga, uye hapana musanganiswa une mutengo wakaderera pachikamu chenzvimbo kupfuura uyu, ndiro hwaro.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.c: Sezvawakangoongorora, ne100 pane musanganiswa unodhura zvishoma kupfuura unopiwa nemutemo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.o.d: Zvakadaro kumirairo yose, zvikamu zvichiva zvingani zvazvo
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.d: Kuti utaure kuti inoshanda kumirairo yose, unofanira kuratidza kuti hapana counterexample, asi pane counterexample ye100 kare.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.explain: 96 inokodzera chaizvo mumabhokisi makuru 8, uye mutengo i12,000원. Kune musanganiswa wega wega, mutengo pachikamu chenzvimbo i125원 kana kupfuura uye panofanira kuva nenzvimbo 96 kana kupfuura, saka mutengo i125×96=12,000원 kana kupfuura. Saka 12,000원 ndiyo yakaderera zvikuru. Mutemo wakarurama kumirairo umo mabhokisi anodhura zvishoma pachinhu chimwe oga anokodzera chaizvo (mamultiples e12), uye kumirairo ine zvasara unofanira kuongorora.

y-m-77-05.title: Kana uchigadzira rondedzero yemitengo ine '25% margin', chii chatinofanira kubvunza kutanga?
y-m-77-05.topic: Hwaro hweratio yemargin nekugadzika mutengo wekutengesa
y-m-77-05.goal: Ziva kuti kunyange peresenti imwe chete inopa kukosha kwakasiyana zvichienderana nekuti ndeyehuwandu hupi, uye nyora semibvunzo hwaro hwaunofanira kuongorora usati wagadzika mutengo.
y-m-77-05.material: Chitoro chezvinyorwa chinoda kugadzika mutengo weropafudzo wechinhu chine mutengo we8,000원. Mutungamiriri wechikwata akati, 'Ndapota gadzika mutengo werondedzero ne25% margin.' Margin imhindu yemutengo werondedzero kubvisa mutengo (mutengo werondedzero − mutengo), uye usatarise mitero nemamwe mari. Mushandi 가 akati, 'Wedzera 25% yemutengo, saka 8,000×1.25=10,000원.' Mushandi 나 akati, 'Mugove wemargin mumutengo werondedzero unofanira kuva 25%, saka kana mutengo werondedzero i P, saka (P−8,000)÷P=0.25, ndiko kuti, P≈10,667원.'
y-m-77-05.thinking.0: Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana uye kunongedzera zvakashayikwa
y-m-77-05.thinking.1: Kugadzira nyaya umo kukosha kweratio kunochinja zvichienderana nehuwandu hwebase
y-m-77-05.thinking.2: Kunyora meseji inokumbira mumwe munhu ruzivo rwunodiwa

y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.1: Uchishandisa mutengo werondedzero wemushandi wega wega, verenga margin ÷ mutengo ne margin ÷ mutengo werondedzero, uye uongorore kuti ndeupi unoita 25%.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.a: Kuverenga kwemushandi 가 kwakarurama. Peresenti inowanzwa nemutengo ndokuwedzerwa, saka equation ya나 haidiwi
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga nemutengo chete. Wakange usina kufunga kuti margin inogona kutaurwawo seratio yemutengo werondedzero.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.b: Kuverenga kwemushandi 나 kwakarurama. Mwero wemhindu unogara wakataurwa seratio yemutengo werondedzero, saka equation ya가 haina kururama
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga nemutengo werondedzero chete. Zvakajairikawo kutaura mwero wemargin seratio yemutengo.

y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.c: Kusanganisa makosha maviri kunopa kukosha kusingaenderani netsananguro ipi neipi. Chokwadi chekuti mabase akasiyana hachina kugadziriswa.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.d: Kuverenga kwose kwakarurama. Tinofanira kubvunza mutungamiriri wechikwata kuti 25% iratio yechii
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakaziva kuti kuverenga kuviri kwakashandisa mabase akasiyana, ukaedza kutanga wasimbisa kuti ndeipi base.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.explain: 가 akadudzira mwero wemargin seratio yemutengo, uye 나 seratio yemutengo werondedzero, uye kuverenga kwega kwega kwakarurama. '25% margin' oga haisarudze kuti ndeipi base, saka mutengo werondedzero haugadzikwi kuita kukosha kumwe. Kana ukasarudza imwe yemaviri zvisina kujeka, ingasiyana nezvinodiwa nemutungamiriri wechikwata.

Kana pane mutengo we c원 nemwero wemargin we m%, gadzira mienzaniso miviri yakasiyana umo musiyano pakati pemutengo werondedzero unobva pamutengo (c×(1+m÷100)) nemutengo werondedzero unobva pamutengo werondedzero (c÷(1−m÷100)) i1,000원 kana kupfuura. c inhamba yechisikigo muzvikamu ze1,000원 (kubva ku1,000 kusvika ku100,000), uye m inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa5 kusvika pa50. Nyaya yemutengo we8,000원 nemwero wemargin we25% ine musiyano unenge 667원, saka haikodzeri mamiriro.
